canonical_project: Rackhost Data Center Budapest / Victor Hugo
notes: Rendszerinformatika's official Victor Hugo datacenter page lists 1132 Budapest, Victor Hugo street 18-22, 70 rack spaces, 270 sqm gross area and 3 kW per rack. Capacity estimate is 70 racks x 3 kW = 210 kW / 0.21 MW. DataCenterMap lists Rackhost Data Center Budapest at the same Victor Hugo address.
